h: The Divine Name Shines Until the Heart Hears

p: It does not write "hear, O earth."
"'Give ear, O heavens, and I will speak,
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רנח, א)
which is the tip of the yud
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב שָׁם חֵלֶק ג סה, ב)
And this is why it wrote "Give ear, O heavens":
HaKadosh Baruch Hu is called heavens
וּבְסֵפֶר הַבָּהִיר שֶׁבְּסוֹף זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב)
and in Sefer HaBahir at the end of Zohar volume II),
that is, the earth will hear of itself,
for the Name Havayah will shine
with the tip of the yud
down to the middah of Knesses Yisrael.
that it will enter the heart of Yisrael of itself,
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר (מִשְׁלֵי טו, לא)
along the lines of what is said (Mishlei 15:31):
and as written (Midrash Rabbah on this parshah):
"the two hundred forty-eight limbs of a person,
the Written Torah is called life,
from the side of the Tree of Life;
וְכֵן תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה נִקְרָא חַיִּים
and likewise the Oral Torah is called life,
in that one merits being from the side of life
and they will merit the Tree of Life.
that they will merit the Oral Torah,
how it is included in the Written Torah.
"The Tree of Life is none other than Torah"
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב רֵישׁ סֵדֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ רַבָּה וְשָׁאָר מְקוֹמוֹת)
(as written at the beginning of Seder Eliyahu Rabbah and elsewhere).
And this is what it says,
that "the supernal holy Name is alluded";
and since it shines from Kesser Elyon,
"and let the earth hear" of itself,
